versions.content: Upon call of Dem_SetEventStatus and after debouncing, the Dem shall process the monitor status in the same manner as the UDS status: • Bit0 (TestFailed) according to [SWS_Dem_00386] • Bit1 (TestNotCompleteThisOperationCycle) according to [SWS_Dem_00394]. The monitor status byte processing shall be done synchronously within the context of the calling Dem_SetEventStatus function.
